description: This file contains unit tests for the CordRepRing class in the Abseil C++ library, specifically testing the ring buffer implementation for string fragments, including creation, modification, and search functionalities.

classes.name: not_a_string_view
classes.description: A helper class representing a non-owning string view with prefix and suffix removal capabilities.

classes.name: CordRingTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing CordRepRing functionalities, managing reference counting cleanup.

classes.name: CordRingTestWithParam
classes.description: A parameterized test fixture class for testing different configurations of CordRepRing.

classes.name: CordRingCreateTest
classes.description: A test fixture for testing creation of CordRepRing instances.

classes.name: CordRingSubTest
classes.description: A test fixture for testing sub-ring operations.

classes.name: CordRingBuildTest
classes.description: A test fixture for testing building and modifying rings.

classes.name: CordRingCreateFromTreeTest
classes.description: A test fixture for testing creation of rings from tree structures.

classes.name: CordRingBuildInputTest
classes.description: A test fixture for testing building rings with various input configurations.

methods.name: ToFlats
methods.description: Extracts the flats (string views) from a CordRepRing.

methods.name: ToRawFlats
methods.description: Extracts raw not-a-string-view representations from a CordRepRing.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a CordRepRing into a concatenated string.

methods.name: MakeFlat
methods.description: Creates a flat node from a string view.

methods.name: MakeExternal
methods.description: Creates an external node from a string view.

methods.name: MakeFakeExternal
methods.description: Creates a fake external node with specified length.

methods.name: MakeLeaf
methods.description: Creates either a flat or external node depending on size.

methods.name: MakeSubstring
methods.description: Creates a substring node from a given node.

methods.name: RemovePrefix
methods.description: Creates a substring node removing a prefix.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Creates a substring node removing a suffix.

methods.name: FromFlats
methods.description: Creates a ring from an array of string flats with specified composition.

methods.name: TestParamToString
methods.description: Converts test parameters to string for display.
